name: strope-translate
description: Build tooling for the Strope Translate WordPress plugin.

scripts.i18n:pot: wp i18n make-pot . languages/strope-translate.pot --domain=strope-translate --exclude=js/src,css,flags,bin,tests,plans,node_modules,vendor,modules/machine-translation/vendor,modules/machine-translation/lib/wasm-worker/js,modules/block-visibility/js,modules/string-discovery/js,modules/translation-status/js && node bin/i18n-fix-paths.mjs
scripts.i18n:compile: wp i18n update-po languages/strope-translate.pot languages && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-php languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
scripts.i18n: npm run build && npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:compile
